# Psalm 51 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David, when Nathan the-prophet came to-him, after he-had-gone-in to Bathsheba.

**2** Be-gracious to-me, O-God, according-to Your-steadfast-love; according-to the-abundance of-Your-compassions blot-out my-transgressions.

**3** Wash-me thoroughly from-my-iniquity, and-from-my-sin cleanse-me.

**4** For my-transgressions I know, and-my-sin [is] before-me continually.

**5** Against-You, You alone, have-I-sinned, and-the-evil in-Your-eyes I-have-done, so-that You-are-justified in-Your-speaking, blameless in-Your-judging.

**6** Behold, in-iniquity I-was-brought-forth, and-in-sin my-mother conceived-me.

**7** Behold, truth You-desire in-the-inward-parts; and-in-the-hidden-part You-make-me-know wisdom.

**8** Purge-me with-hyssop, and-I-shall-be-clean; wash-me, and-I-shall-be whiter than-snow.

**9** Let-me-hear joy and-gladness; let-the-bones You-have-crushed rejoice.

**10** Hide Your-face from-my-sins, and-all my-iniquities blot-out.

**11** A-clean heart create for-me, O-God, and-a-steadfast spirit renew within-me.

**12** Do-not cast-me from-Your-presence, and-Your-Holy Spirit do-not take from-me.

**13** Restore to-me the-joy of-Your-salvation, and-[with] a-willing spirit sustain-me.

**14** I-will-teach transgressors Your-ways, and-sinners to-You shall-return.

**15** Deliver-me from-bloodguilt, O-God, God of-my-salvation, [and] my-tongue shall-sing-aloud of-Your-righteousness.

**16** Lord, open my-lips, and-my-mouth shall-declare Your-praise.

**17** For You-do-not desire sacrifice — and-I-would-give [it]; burnt-offering You-do-not delight-in.

**18** The-sacrifices of-God [are] a-broken spirit; a-broken and-contrite heart, O-God, You-will-not despise.

**19** Do-good in-Your-favor to-Zion; build the-walls of-Jerusalem.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **51:5**: 'Against You, You alone' — a radical theological claim. Though David sinned against Uriah and Bathsheba, the ultimate offense was against God.

- **51:11**: 'Create' (bara) — the verb used only of God in the OT (Gen 1:1). A clean heart requires divine creation, not human effort.

- **51:12**: 'Your Holy Spirit' — one of only three explicit OT references to the 'Holy Spirit' (also Isa 63:10-11).

— EMET
